INNOVA X 2026 — GLOBAL ONLINE HACKATHON:
Build • Innovate • Impact

Overview:

  • INNOVA X 2026 is a global online hackathon inviting students, developers, AI enthusiasts, innovators, researchers, designers, and technology builders to create innovative solutions for real-world problems using AI and emerging technologies.

Official WhatsApp Community:

  • Join the WhatsApp Community

Event Details:

  • Mode: Online.
  • Registration Fee: ₹299 per team.
  • Team Size: 1–4 members.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • Inter-specialization teams are allowed.
  • Interdisciplinary teams are encouraged.

Challenge Tracks:

  • AI For Healthcare: Build AI solutions that improve healthcare accessibility, patient support, preventive care, or medical workflows.
  • AI For Agriculture: Create AI-powered solutions for smart farming, crop health, agricultural intelligence, food security, or rural communities.
  • AI For Climate & Sustainability: Use AI to address environmental challenges, energy optimization, waste management, water conservation, or climate-related problems.
  • AI For Safety & Disaster Response: Develop AI solutions for emergency response, risk detection, cybersecurity, public safety, or disaster management.
  • Open Innovation — AI For The Future: Build an innovative AI-powered solution for any meaningful real-world problem.

Prizes:

  • 1st Prize:
    • 1 Month Claude Pro Subscription.
    • 1 Month Global Remote Internship with Innovation Hacks.
    • 1 Year Web Domain.
  • 2nd Prize:
    • 1 Month ChatGPT Plus Subscription.
    • 1 Month Global Remote Internship with Innovation Hacks.
    • 1 Year Web Domain.
  • 3rd Prize:
    • 1 Month Standard Plan.
    • 250 Credits.
    • 1 Month Global Remote Internship with Innovation Hacks.
    • 1 Year Web Domain.

Hackathon Process:

  • Register your team on Unstop.
  • Choose one challenge track.
  • Build your AI-powered solution.
  • Submit your project before the announced deadline.
  • The top three teams will be declared winners.

Judging Criteria:

  • Innovation & Creativity.
  • Technical Implementation.
  • Problem-Solving.
  • Real-World Impact.
  • User Experience.
  • Overall Presentation.

Rules:

  • Team size: 1–4 members.
  • Inter-college and interdisciplinary teams are allowed.
  • Each team can select only one problem statement.
  • Projects must be original work.
  • Plagiarism and copied submissions are prohibited.
  • Participants may use AI tools, APIs, open-source libraries, and publicly available technologies.
  • Previously completed projects should not be submitted without substantial development.
  • Organizers reserve the right to disqualify submissions violating the rules.
  • Judges' decisions will be final.

Why Participate:

  • Compete in a global innovation challenge.
  • Build with AI and emerging technologies.
  • Solve real-world problems.
  • Win premium technology prizes.
  • Gain a Global Remote Internship opportunity with Innovation Hacks.
  • Get a 1-year web domain through the winning prizes.
  • Turn your idea into a working solution.

Organizer:

  • Shree Venkateshwara Hi-Tech Engineering College, Erode, Tamil Nadu.

Powered & Sponsored By:

  • Innovation Hacks.
